Argonne calculated the average daily FWI value by season for each year within a given scenario (e.g., 
mid-century RCP4.5) and climate model (e.g., CCSM). The seasons are segmented as winter (Dec, Jan, 
Feb), spring (March, April, May), summer (June, July, Aug), and autumn (Sep, Oct, Nov). Each year’s 
seasonal average daily FWI was used to calculate a decadal average daily FWI value for that season (e.g., 
the average daily FWI value in winter at mid-century under RCP4.5). This process was repeated across all 
scenarios and all three climate models (CCSM, GFDL, and HadGEM), followed by calculating the multi-
model ensemble mean of each scenario’s seasonal average daily FWI value.
